Q0_s1.explanation: The unit mainly responds to blotched or mottled animal skin patterns, most strongly the scales of coiled snakes. It responds more weakly to related textured animal coats such as leopard and snow-leopard spots, shaggy fur, otters, rodents and a speckled bird.

parsed.explanation: The unit mainly responds to blotched or mottled animal skin patterns, most strongly the scales of coiled snakes. It responds more weakly to related textured animal coats such as leopard and snow-leopard spots, shaggy fur, otters, rodents and a speckled bird.
parsed.evidence: The three strongest images (and #6, #19) are blotch-patterned snakes, and most of the rest of the top 20 are spotted or furry animals with the box on the patterned coat or face. However, several non-animal hits (guitar, school bus/snow, pool table, oven, child in dishwasher) at 7-8, and random images reaching 3-4, suggest the unit is fairly broad or partly polysemantic.
parsed.missing_data: Activations on non-snake mottled textures (e.g., camouflage, gravel, patterned fabric) and more of the activation distribution beyond the top 20, to tell whether the non-animal hits are noise or a second feature.

F1_s1.explanation: The unit responds to dense, repeating blotchy or mottled surface patterns: irregular dark patches or rings on a lighter, often warm-toned background, especially on curved or coiled surfaces. Weaker responses come from other fine repeating structure, such as parallel thin lines, grid-like meshes, and speckled or grainy textures.

parsed.explanation: The unit responds to dense, repeating blotchy or mottled surface patterns: irregular dark patches or rings on a lighter, often warm-toned background, especially on curved or coiled surfaces. Weaker responses come from other fine repeating structure, such as parallel thin lines, grid-like meshes, and speckled or grainy textures.
parsed.evidence: The strongest activations (7-10) fall on regions covered in irregular blotches, rosettes or speckles. Several lower top-20 hits fall on regularly spaced lines, wire meshes or coarse grain. Random photos without such repeated patterning score only 1-4.
parsed.missing_data: Synthetic texture probes, such as blotch patterns versus stripes and grids with color and curvature varied, would show whether the line and mesh hits are the same texture preference or a separate response.
